INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs;
SET force_download = true;
WITH vp AS (SELECT header, unnest(entity) AS e FROM read_json('http://sources-data/mbta/realtime/VehiclePositions_enhanced.json', maximum_object_size = 50000000))
SELECT
  e.vehicle.vehicle.id AS vehicle,
  e.vehicle.vehicle.label AS unit,
  e.vehicle.trip.route_id AS route,
  CASE
    WHEN e.vehicle.trip.route_id IN ('Red', 'Orange', 'Blue', 'Mattapan') OR e.vehicle.trip.route_id LIKE 'Green-%' THEN 'Subway'
    WHEN e.vehicle.trip.route_id LIKE 'CR-%' THEN 'Commuter rail'
    WHEN e.vehicle.trip.route_id LIKE 'Boat-%' THEN 'Ferry'
    ELSE 'Bus'
  END AS mode,
  e.vehicle.position.latitude AS latitude,
  e.vehicle.position.longitude AS longitude,
  CASE e.vehicle.current_status
    WHEN 'IN_TRANSIT_TO' THEN 'In transit'
    WHEN 'STOPPED_AT' THEN 'Stopped at stop'
    WHEN 'INCOMING_AT' THEN 'Arriving at stop'
    ELSE 'No data'
  END AS status,
  CASE e.vehicle.occupancy_status
    WHEN 'EMPTY' THEN 'Empty'
    WHEN 'MANY_SEATS_AVAILABLE' THEN 'Many seats'
    WHEN 'FEW_SEATS_AVAILABLE' THEN 'Few seats'
    WHEN 'STANDING_ROOM_ONLY' THEN 'Standing room only'
    WHEN 'CRUSHED_STANDING_ROOM_ONLY' THEN 'Crushed'
    WHEN 'FULL' THEN 'Full'
    WHEN 'NOT_ACCEPTING_PASSENGERS' THEN 'Not accepting passengers'
    ELSE 'No data'
  END AS occupancy,
  (header.timestamp - e.vehicle.timestamp)::DOUBLE AS age_s
FROM vp

INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs;
-- Aggregated on the server, per hour, line, route and station: the browser gets
-- sums, from which means, excess wait and shares recombine exactly.
WITH d AS (
  SELECT trunk_route_id AS line, route_id, parent_station,
         to_timestamp(stop_timestamp) AS t,
         coalesce(headway_branch_seconds, headway_trunk_seconds) AS h,
         coalesce(scheduled_headway_branch, scheduled_headway_trunk) AS hs
  FROM read_parquet([
    'http://sources-data/mbta/lamp/subway-on-time-performance-v1/' || strftime(d, '%Y-%m-%d') || '-subway-on-time-performance-v1.parquet'
    FOR d IN generate_series(
      least(greatest(CAST($__timeFrom() AS TIMESTAMPTZ)::DATE, CAST($__timeTo() AS TIMESTAMPTZ)::DATE - 30), (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::DATE - 1),
      least(CAST($__timeTo() AS TIMESTAMPTZ)::DATE, (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::DATE - 1),
      INTERVAL 1 DAY)
  ])
),
ok AS (SELECT * FROM d WHERE t IS NOT NULL AND h > 0 AND hs > 0 AND h < 3600 AND hs < 3600)
SELECT date_trunc('hour', t) AS hour, line, route_id, parent_station,
       count(*)::DOUBLE AS n, sum(h)::DOUBLE AS sum_h, sum(h * h)::DOUBLE AS sum_h2,
       sum(hs)::DOUBLE AS sum_hs, sum(hs * hs)::DOUBLE AS sum_hs2,
       (count(*) FILTER (WHERE h < 0.25 * hs))::DOUBLE AS bunched,
       (count(*) FILTER (WHERE h > 1.5 * hs))::DOUBLE AS gaps
FROM ok GROUP BY ALL

targets.rawSql:
SELECT mode AS "Mode", count(*)::DOUBLE AS "Vehicles", (count(*) FILTER (WHERE age_s > 90))::DOUBLE AS "Positions older than 90 s", max(age_s) AS "Oldest position"
FROM $vehicles WHERE mode IN ($mode) AND route IN ($route) AND status IN ($status) AND occupancy IN ($occupancy)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

-- Unfiltered on purpose: kepler filters the map on the GPU.
SELECT vehicle, unit, route, mode, latitude, longitude, status, occupancy, age_s FROM $vehicles

SELECT line AS "Line", sum(n)::DOUBLE AS "Samples",
       round(sum(sum_h) / sum(n) / 60, 1) AS "Actual (mean, min)",
       round(sum(sum_hs) / sum(n) / 60, 1) AS "Scheduled (mean, min)",
       round((sum(sum_h2) / (2 * sum(sum_h)) - sum(sum_hs2) / (2 * sum(sum_hs))) / 60, 2) AS "Excess wait",
       round(100 * sum(bunched) / sum(n), 1) AS "Bunched %",
       round(100 * sum(gaps) / sum(n), 1) AS "Gaps %"
FROM $lamp
WHERE 'Subway' IN ($mode) AND route_id IN ($route) AND $__timeFilter(hour)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

PIVOT (
  SELECT hour AS time, line, 100 * sum(gaps) / sum(n) AS gaps
  FROM $lamp
  WHERE 'Subway' IN ($mode) AND route_id IN ($route) AND $__timeFilter(hour)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
) ON line USING first(gaps) ORDER BY time
